newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn posts gains as soybeans surge, funds buy.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn posts gains as soybeans surge, funds buy.

text.p: CBOT corn futures opened higher on Wednesday, lifted by fund buying and strong gains in soybeans, traders said.

Refco Inc and Lind-Waldock were said to be aggressive buyers of December while ABN-AMRO Chicago Corp was again on the sell side. Traders said ABN-AMRO sold up to 40 million bushels of corn on Tuesday.
But good crop weather in the U.S. Midwest capped gains.
Trade sources also pointed to position squaring ahead of Thursday's USDA weekly export sales report and Friday's USDA Supply and Demand Outlook.

In early trade, Refco Inc bought three million bushels December, Lind-Waldock bought 2.5 million December and Continental Grain bought one million December. ABN-AMRO sold at least 2.5 million December, traders said.
At 0955 CDT, corn was up 3-1/4 to 2-1/2 cents per bushel with December up 3-1/4 at $2.33.
